results.evidence: The pass-opening history shows SR-20 usually reopening in the second half of April or in May (median around mid-May; 2019-2025 openings all 5-24 May), never as late as mid/late June except the 1974 record. SummitPost states the highway is usually closed from late November until early April, and WSDOT's 2026 notice reopened the east side on April 30. The trailhead directions' 'mid-to-late June' opening is wrong; the itinerary cal line refers to climbable conditions (road open AND gully snow-free) and is left alone.
